poC_details: Scope: Dedicated pool with 3 reserved GPU workers; deploy two model variants (ft-small and ft-medium) for canary/fallback testing

Goals: validate latency SLOs (p95 < 250ms for chat in NA), verify canary rollout automation, demonstrate region failover between us-east1 and us-west1, confirm cost telemetry and per-route cost breakdown
Success criteria: automated canary traffic shift with 0 critical errors; failover completed under simulated region outage (< 90s end-to-end); token cost per 1k tokens within forecasted range
Metrics collected: p50/p95 latency, tail latency, error rate, tokens per request, per-route cost, KV cache hit rate
technical_requirements: Workloads: chat + embeddings + reranking for search relevance
Latency targets: p95 chat < 250ms for regional traffic; background batch embeddings throughput 200 qps during off-peak
Cost sensitivity: target blended token cost that improves on current in-house GPU by >= 30%
Model preferences: OSS base models with Redwood-verified quantization; want ability to pin to exact model version
Routing/fallback needs: canary rollout per percentage, automatic fallback to smaller model variant on high latency/errors, cross-region failover, and per-customer routing policy
Observability: token-level cost, per-route dashboards, request tracing, and automated regression alerts tied to prompt sets
Security: SSO/SAML integration, KMS for key management, audit logs retention 1 year, optional data residency for EU customers
pricing_concerns: Finance wants a clear TCO comparison: current infra vs Redwood Dedicated over 12 months
